name: Informed Technology
summary: Perth dial-up ISP, WAIA member 2000; no evidence of operation after ~2006 (INFORMED TECHNOLOGY PTY LTD, ACN 085 210 564).

events.details: No evidence of operation after ~2006.. Ceased as an ISP — entity ABN cancelled 15 Jun 2010.. Wayback holds no ISP-era homepage, but the domain answered with a control panel in Sep 2008 and the operator's ABN was cancelled 15 Jun 2010 — the current c. 2006 death is too early; settle by Jun 2010.

refs.label: Domain responds 200/301 but serves a blank 114-byte page — no services offered
Hosting control-panel login live on the domain 14 Sep 2008; the ISP-era homepage itself is not archived (blank/parked from Oct 2016).
